name: in-professional-tax
description: Use this skill whenever asked about Indian professional tax (profession tax) for FY 2026-27. Trigger on phrases like professional tax India, profession tax, state professional tax, Telangana professional tax, Maharashtra or Karnataka professional tax, PT registration, PT enrolment, PT return, Form V, profession tax deduction from salary, section 19 deduction, or any question about profession tax rates, registration, payment or income tax treatment in India. It gives the constitutional ceiling, the Telangana schedule bands most clients fall in, Telangana registration, payment, interest and penalties, and the income tax treatment under the Income-tax Act 2025 (deduction only for a person who opts out of the section 202 default regime). For other States it gives the steps to find their own schedule and no figures. Tier 2, not reviewed by an accountant.
